title: Camera presets: nametag flicker
intro: Stand near your pawns so their nametags show. You'll pick each built-in preset in the CameraDistance menu (Quick Presets) and judge the nametags by eye. Note any preset that still flickers and tell me.

steps.text: Open the menu (Insert), pick OVER-THE-SHOULDER, close the menu, walk around near the pawns. Flicker? Then press End
Pick CLASSIC RPG, close the menu, walk around. Flicker? Press End
Pick MONSTER HUNTER / WIDE, close the menu, walk and fight if you can. Flicker? Press End
Pick PANORAMIC, close the menu, walk. Flicker? Press End
Pick RTS (the tilted view may still flicker; the tilt isn't moved yet). Press End
Pick your usual preset again (Vanilla with distance 4.5) and press End
